mentions.name: Gamepad Typing Input Method
mentions.description: This project is a new text entry method for gamepads, designed around gamepad hardware itself rather than forcing gamepad input to fit a QWERTY keyboard layout. A demo was planned to be available for HN users to try.
mentions.problem: Typing on gamepads is usually done by awkwardly fitting gamepad input to a QWERTY keyboard layout instead of designing the input method around the hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt: A new way to type on gamepads designed around the hardware rather than trying to fit gamepad input to a qwerty keyboard.

evidence.value: A new way to type on gamepads designed around the hardware rather than trying to fit gamepad input to a qwerty keyboard.
